info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Customer Management By Param1-spec
info.description: The Customer Event History Retrieval API allows users to access a comprehensive history of customer events based on specified parameters. This endpoint is vital for businesses aiming to track customer interactions and behaviors effectively. Typical consumers include customer support teams and business analysts who utilize the data for insights and decision-making. By fetching historical data, organizations can enhance their customer service and improve overall customer experience.

get.summary: Retrieve Event History for a Customer
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the event history associated with a specific customer, identified by their unique customer ID (CUST-100045). It provides detailed insights into interactions or activities related to the customer, helping in effective customer management.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the event history for a specific customer identified by ID 'CUST-100045'. It requires the necessary parameters in JSON format, adhering to the defined schema.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the customer event history.

GetCustomerManagementByParam1Request.title: Customer Event History Request Body
GetCustomerManagementByParam1Request.description: Schema representing the request body for fetching customer event history with a specific identifier.

customerId.description: The unique identifier for the customer.

partyId.description: The unique identifier for the party associated with the customer.

productCode.description: The code associated with the product linked to the customer.

effectiveDate.description: The date when the customer's record became effective.

relationshipTier.description: The tier of the relationship the customer has with the organization.

recordStatus.description: The status of the customer record.

version.description: The version number of the customer record.

updatedAt.description: The timestamp when the record was last updated.

responseId.description: The unique identifier for the response.

correlationId.description: The correlation ID for tracking the request.

generatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the response was generated.

processingRegion.description: The region where the processing of the request took place.

metadata.description: Additional metadata related to the response.

GetCustomerManagementByParam1Response_20.description: Schema representing the event history response for a customer.

X-Endpoint-Id.description: A unique identifier for the endpoint that was called. This helps in tracing the specific endpoint used during the API request.

X-Runtime-App.description: The name or identifier of the application that executed the request. This aids in understanding which application instance was responsible for handling the request.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme utilizes bearer tokens for authentication. A valid JSON Web Token (JWT) must be included in the 'Authorization' header as a bearer token to access secured endpoints.
